correctness.rationale: The test polynomial P=(t-a)(t-b) gives exact interval moments; normalized separation ratio uniquely maximizes at symmetric pair with squared half-gap 1/(4 sqrt5); monic norm bound proves uniform upper bound. The q^2 satellite plus q-q^2 main band yields the lower via a 1D null space, U-block spectral bound Omega(q^2), and O(q^4) Schur correction. Center/length rigidity follows from equality forces in both upper factors. The standalone checker verifies identities and numerical asymptotics; finite checks are not proofs.

value.rationale: The object is an explicit E-optimal continuous-sensing stability quantity for the first three radial Zernike modes and exactly two annular components. Changing one connected aperture to two changes the *sharp asymptotic power* of the worst-mode energy from q^5 to q^3, and the unique limiting radii with vanishingly small second exposure is a nontrivial experimental-design boundary phenomenon. The exact constant and geometry guide constrained annular mask design rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
